entities.summary: Malangu Kabedi Mbuyi, also Malangu Kabedi-Mbuyi, is a Congolese economist who was appointed Governor of the Central Bank of the Congo (BCC), on 30 June 2021. BCC is the central bank and national banking regulator in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Malangu Kabedi is the first woman to serve as governor of the Central Bank of the Congo since the bank was established in 1961.
